These signals point to reduced defensive positioning and a risk‑on tilt. Yet Brent's drop to $104.61 (-2.81%) and ongoing Hormuz conflict inject a modest bearish bias, capping the score at 4/10.

Il Brent è sceso del 2.81% a $104.61, alimentando timori inflazionistici, mentre l'oro è quasi stabile (+0.04%). Il DXY è marginalmente più forte (+0.03%). In sintesi, il rischio on è prevalente ma l'incertezza sul prezzo del petrolio e la tensione geopolitica moderano l'entusiasmo.
market_impact_summary.en: In Friday's close equities showed mixed signals: the S&P 500 +0.86% and FTSE MIB +1.36%, while the STOXX 600 -0.81% and Nikkei -1.93%. US Treasuries (TLT) edged up (+0.11%) with the 10Y yield at 4.97%, indicating slight rate compression. Brent fell 2.81% to $104.61, reviving inflation concerns, whereas gold was flat (+0.04%). The DXY edged higher (+0.03%). Overall, risk‑on sentiment dominates but oil price volatility and ongoing geopolitical tension temper optimism.

audio_narrative_en.text: Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. The markets are observing the weekend pause.

Pressure on U.S. fiscal debt and its international implications could swing equity markets, with potential effects on the energy sector and Treasuries.
